fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-07-06 at about 12:40, it was reported that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 12,000 was withdrawn. The online submission was made by Dharani Gopal (9000000072). The complaint mentions Chandran Subramani, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000064, in connection with the events. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100094. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00329, as the mobile number 9000000064 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim was allegedly induced to approve a collect request on a UPI app.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, afternoon, receiving account, suspect, apartment complex, mobile number, digital document
